verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Terraform has a first-party workspace concept: state is described as belonging to 'your workspace' (terraform-docs-20), and HCP Terraform documents workspaces with their own UI and policy runs (terraform-docs-9, terraform-docs-35). Nothing shows these workspaces being used to separate dev, staging and prod configuration, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: documentation of the workspace CLI commands or per-environment workspace/stack setup, per-environment variable or config separation, a Stacks feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
